name: Prolific
description_en:
Prolific connects research teams with paid participants and human-feedback contributors, using audience filters, screening and study-tool links or APIs.

For UX work it supplies recruitment and submission management around a research task; compensation, platform fees, sample suitability and review obligations remain part of the researcher’s job.
description_zh:
Prolific 通过人群筛选、筛选题、研究工具链接或 API，将研究团队与有偿参与者及人类反馈贡献者连接。

在 UX 工作中，它围绕研究任务提供招募和提交管理；报酬、平台费、样本适用性及审核责任仍由研究者考虑。

core_features.name_en: Recruitment connected to existing study tools
core_features.name_zh: 连接既有研究工具的招募
core_features.explanation_en: The research and pricing pages describe linking an external data-collection tool by URL or using API integrations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 研究及价格页描述通过 URL 连接外部数据收集工具，或使用 API 集成。

core_features.explanation_en: Platform use has no monthly subscription fee; project costs combine participant rewards and a platform fee.
core_features.explanation_zh: 平台不收月订阅费，项目成本由参与者报酬和平台费组成。

core_features.explanation_en: The help policy distinguishes approval/payment, justified rejection and return for incomplete work, technical issues or withdrawal.
core_features.explanation_zh: 帮助政策区分批准付款、有依据的拒绝，以及未完成、技术问题或撤回等情况下的退回。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: No monthly platform subscription. Participant reward plus usual platform fee 42.8% corporate/33.3% academic or nonprofit. Recommended hourly GBP 9/USD 12; minimum GBP 6/USD 8. Specialists may cost more. Managed services custom. Free signup does not mean free participant data.

sections.title_en: Recruit around the task you actually need to run
sections.en:
Prolific’s current site serves research and AI evaluation/training. For UX research, its documented route is to identify a target audience, connect the existing survey or testing tool using a URL or integration and collect participant submissions. The platform price page lists audience filters, custom screening, representative/quota samples, workspaces and direct participant messaging. Those options support sampling decisions; they do not automatically make every recruited group representative of a product’s users.

For a hypothetical navigation study, prepare and pilot the task in the actual testing tool before recruiting. Define which product experience or demographic characteristics matter, estimate the real time required and arrange the study’s completion handoff. Check that the external tool can preserve the participant identifier without exposing unnecessary personal information. No external study, participant order, completion redirect or API call was executed here.
sections.zh:
Prolific 现行网站服务研究和 AI 评估/训练。UX 研究的文档路径是识别目标人群，通过 URL 或集成连接既有问卷/测试工具，再收集参与者提交。平台价格页列出人群筛选、自定义筛选题、代表性/配额抽样、工作区和参与者私信。这些选项支持抽样决策，但不会让每个招募群体自动代表产品用户。

以导航研究为假设，应先在实际测试工具中准备并试运行任务，再招募。定义重要的产品经验或人口特征、估算真实耗时，并安排完成状态交接。检查外部工具能否保留参与者识别码，同时避免暴露不必要个人信息。本研究未执行外部研究、参与者订单、完成重定向或 API 调用。

sections.title_en: Budget participant time plus the applicable fee
sections.title_zh: 预算参与者时间及适用费用
sections.en:
The platform is pay as you go without a monthly subscription charge; managed services are custom and usually scoped through a Statement of Work. The pricing FAQ says platform fees are usually 42.8% for corporate customers and 33.3% for academic/nonprofit customers. These are stated usual rates, not confirmation of an individual organization’s eligibility or final invoice.

Prolific recommends at least GBP 9/USD 12 per hour and sets a minimum GBP 6/USD 8 per hour, with higher compensation recommended for specialized skills. As an illustration,100 people completing a 10-minute task at USD 12/hour require USD 200 in participant rewards before platform fees, taxes or specialist costs. The estimate must use realistic completion time; underestimating the task is not a sound way to lower a research budget. No wallet funding, payment, invoice or fee exemption was tested.
sections.zh:
平台按量付费，不收月订阅费；托管服务定制，通常通过工作说明书确定范围。价格 FAQ 说企业平台费通常为 42.8%，学术/非营利通常为 33.3%。这些是列明的常见费率，不证明某组织符合优惠资格，也不是最终发票确认。

Prolific 建议至少每小时 GBP9/USD12，最低允许 GBP6/USD8，并建议对专业技能提高报酬。举例而言，100 人各完成十分钟任务、按每小时 USD12 计，需要 USD200 参与者报酬，尚未包含平台费、税或专业招募成本。估算应使用真实完成时间，低估任务时长不是合理降低研究预算的方法。本研究未测试钱包充值、付款、发票或费率豁免。

sections.title_en: Identity controls do not replace a research design
sections.title_zh: 身份控制不能代替研究设计
sections.en:
Prolific describes Protocol as a layered quality system with identity verification, ongoing fraud checks, in-study authenticity signals, performance controls and participant rewards. Its quality page advertises specific AI/bot detection accuracy and a conditional 100% Human Guarantee. Those are vendor claims, not independent measurements or an unconditional guarantee that every answer is accurate. The guarantee’s detailed qualification terms were not read, so no automatic refund entitlement is assumed.

The current price page describes 300,000+ active participants and 40+ countries, particularly the US, UK and Europe. Do not extrapolate those totals into availability for a narrow profession, country or lived experience. Predefine target eligibility, quality checks and missing-data handling, and inspect whether exclusions change the sample. Completion speed and panel verification cannot by themselves remove question bias, nonresponse bias or errors in the external research tool.
sections.zh:
Prolific 将 Protocol 描述为分层质量系统，包括身份验证、持续反欺诈、研究内真实性信号、表现控制和参与者报酬。质量页宣传具体 AI/机器人检测准确率及附条件的 100% Human Guarantee。这些是厂商声明，未独立测量，也不无条件保证每个回答准确。保证资格细则未实读，因此不能推定自动退款权益。

当前价格页描述 300,000+ 活跃参与者、40+ 国家，尤其集中在美国、英国和欧洲。不能将总量外推为特定职业、国家或经历人群的可用量。应预先定义资格、质量检查和缺失数据处理，并检查排除是否改变样本。完成速度和面板验证本身不能消除问题偏差、无回答偏差或外部研究工具错误。

sections.title_en: Review completed work before penalizing a participant
sections.title_zh: 处罚参与者前先审核已完成工作
sections.en:
The April 21,2026 help policy says completed submissions that provide data should be approved and paid unless specific rejection criteria apply. It distinguishes rejection, which can penalize the participant, from a return that reopens a study place. Technical problems, partial completion, consent withdrawal and other specified situations can justify requesting a return, with partial payment worth considering where work was done.

The same policy says submissions taking less than half the estimated time are flagged for manual review rather than automatically approved; a speed flag is not itself a blanket instruction to reject. If consent is withdrawn, the guide also calls for deleting the participant’s data in external software. Researchers therefore need a submission-to-data mapping and time reserved for review. This profile does not claim every advertised automatic quality feature follows the same rule, and no rejection or return was performed.
sections.zh:
2026 年 4 月 21 日帮助政策说，已完成且提供数据的提交应批准并付款，除非符合具体拒绝条件。它区分会处罚参与者的拒绝，与重新开放研究名额的退回。技术问题、部分完成、撤回同意及其他列明情形可能需要申请退回，已完成部分工作时可考虑部分报酬。

同一政策说，耗时不到预估一半的提交会标记为人工审核，而非自动批准；速度标记本身不是一概拒绝的指令。撤回同意时，指南还要求删除外部软件中的参与者数据。因此研究者需要维护提交到数据的映射，并预留审核时间。本记录不声称所有宣传的自动质量功能都遵循相同规则，也未执行拒绝或退回。

sections.title_en: Participant sourcing is one part of the evidence chain
sections.title_zh: 参与者来源只是证据链的一部分
sections.en:
The research page describes using familiar external tools and APIs, while managed services add custom sourcing, quality assurance and project support. Choose the route based on whether the team can design the study, manage data and review submissions itself. A self-serve participant source does not establish that a third-party recorder, prototype player or survey has been validated.

The public privacy/legal landing page points to notices and terms, but the underlying researcher agreement, detailed data retention, wallet refunds and account-specific protections were not established in this reading. Review them alongside the external tool’s consent and storage conditions before sensitive work. The record remains a documentation-based draft: no recruitment, participant authenticity, compensation transaction, research result or statistical representativeness was tested.
sections.zh:
研究页描述使用熟悉的外部工具及 API；托管服务增加定制招募、质量控制和项目支持。应根据团队能否自行设计研究、管理数据及审核提交选择路径。自助参与者来源不能证明第三方录像、原型播放器或问卷已经验证。

公开隐私/法律入口指向通知和条款，但本次读取未建立完整研究者协议、具体数据保留、钱包退款和账户专属保护。开展敏感研究前，应与外部工具的同意和存储条件一起检查。本记录仍是文档研究草稿，未实测招募、参与者真实性、报酬交易、研究结果或统计代表性。
